verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs describe Read Replicas as additional databases kept in sync with the primary, used for load balancing, lower latency and redundancy. That covers the 'add read replicas' half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents high-availability or automatic failover behavior, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented HA/failover behavior (automatic promotion, failover timing, RTO/RPO), details on adding and managing replicas, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
